title: One Command Check for AI Coding Agents (Copy It)
description:
Your AI agent can't tell if its code works. Give it one command that can! 🔍

✅ Add a check script to package.json
✅ Run the type check first, then the tests
✅ Green output means the agent is done

Day 1 of Agent Harness. Next up: Day 2, Block Bad Commits with a Pre-Commit Gate.
Follow for a new short every day and build AI agents you can trust.

comment: Types or tests: which would you check first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: add the check command to your agent's instructions file (like AGENTS.md) so it runs it before saying it is done.
